simple.meaning: אֵטוּן (ʼêṭûwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, twisted (yarn), i.e. tapestry.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H330. etuwn אֵטוּן noun [masculine] thread, yarn (etymology unknown; on form see Ges 84a. 12. R. Talmud אַטוּנָא אֵטוּנָא, , cord, rope ; so ᵑ7 ) construct ׳א מִצְרַיִם Prov 7:16 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (probably meaning to bind);
